description_en: Queries the details of the bills for the burstable clean bandwidth
description_zh: 查询弹性业务带宽的账单详情
name: DescribeSystemLog

parameters.help_en:
The type of the system log. Set the value to 20, which indicates the billing logs for the burstable clean bandwidth.

You must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的系统日志的类型。取值固定为20，表示弹性业务带宽出账日志。

必须设置该参数，否则会调用失败
parameters.name: entity_type

parameters.help_en:
The IP address of the instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91490.html operation to query the IP addresses of all instances
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS高防实例的IP地址。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91490.html查询DDoS高防实例的IP地址
parameters.name: entity_object

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The bills of the burstable clean bandwidth that are issued after this point in time are queried. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 设置起始时间，查询在该起始时间后出账的弹性业务带宽账单。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The bills of the burstable clean bandwidth that are issued before this point in time are queried. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 设置结束时间，查询在该结束时间前出账的弹性业务带宽账单。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置每页包含日志的数量
parameters.name: page_size
